## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing problem it addresses.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] No build outputs, caches, logs, credentials, or private URLs included.

- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices updated where needed.
- [ ] Platform-specific checks are accurately described.

## Notes for reviewers

List design decisions, limitations, and follow-up work.
